p: The ad opens asking 'Still deploying to Vercel just to show a doc?' before showing a shared design doc, an inline comment requesting a timeline cut, a terminal prompt instructing an AI agent to apply comments, and the updated document reflecting the revised plan at the same URL with resolved threads.
Artifact Share lets teams comment directly on shared HTML artifacts and have AI agents update the same document URL directly.

The demonstration clearly communicates the developer workflow from inline comment to agent-driven in-place doc update. Pacing is consistent and text remains legible throughout. Small UI text in the terminal and doc metadata is slightly dense for small mobile feed widths, but main headings and captions carry the core narrative effectively.

p: The demonstrated workflow (comment on doc, CLI applies edit, doc republishes at v2) is legible and product-forward, and text/UI renders cleanly with no artifacts. But the opening frame is a small-text decision-doc screenshot with no motion or provocation, so it likely won't stop a scroll on X, and it doesn't deliver the stated 'Vercel workaround' hook at all. The 'any agent' half of the message is asserted only in the closing tagline, not demonstrated, since every screenshot shows Claude Code specifically, and the CTA card is flat and generic rather than compelling a click.
